en: Multi-view black-and-white postcard showing several landmarks of a city: a large Romanesque cathedral with four towers and a terraced fountain in front, panoramic views over a hilly city with a prominent cross on a rocky outcrop, modern public buildings and squares, a curving road around a hillside complex, a lookout tower in a wooded area, a decorative urn in a park, and a large outdoor swimming pool. At the bottom front, Hungarian text reads "ÜDVÖZLET PÉCSRŐL." The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text in red ink, a Hungarian stamp, postmark, and printed publisher details.
